name: session-activity
description: A pane of this session's todo list (now, next and done, with each item's ticket), subagents and background servers and scripts: verdicts and routing checks per agent, ports, CPU and memory, stop and orphan cleanup

onExit.title: On session exit
onExit.description: What to do with background servers and orphaned processes still running when the session ends

notifyAfterSeconds.title: Notify after (seconds)
notifyAfterSeconds.description: Send a notification when a background script that ran at least this long finishes; 0 turns it off

quietMinutes.title: Flag quiet scripts after (minutes)
quietMinutes.description: Mark a running script with no listening port as quiet when it has printed nothing for this long

clearFinishedAfterMinutes.title: Clear finished after (minutes)
clearFinishedAfterMinutes.description: Remove completed and stopped scripts from the pane this long after they end; failed ones stay until cleared. 0 keeps them all
